messages:
Nina (product): Heads up 1 - Enterprise pilot (FinBridge) just said they wont go Dedicated without a clear evidence export SLA: verifiable signatures, time-stamped proof, and retention lanes incl. long-tail. Can we draft a minimal launch checklist?
Kai (eng-runtime): Short answer: yes. Minimal tech pieces: export manifest with per-file sha256, signer_id+key_version, and a signed envelope. We can use AsymmetricSign (customer-managed or Redwood HSM) and include optional RFC3161 timestamp token.
Omar (security): Rotation is the tricky bit. Requirement: old exports remain verifiable after tenant key rotation. Add key_version to manifest and keep a time-ordered public-key history that tenants can upload or we can store (with consent). Threat model doc will cover compromise/escrow options.
Rhea (ops): From ops: we must offer retention tiers. Proposal: Hot (90d indexed, sub-5s), Warm (2y, sub-30s), Cold (7y archive, search within 24-72h). Provide opt-in billing for long-term indexing. Also need legal-hold that blocks purge cycles.
Nina (product): Proposed pilot acceptance checklist: 1) Signed export manifest (verifiable), 2) RFC3161 timestamp or equivalent, 3) Retention lanes (hot/warm/cold) and legal-hold, 4) BYOK + preserved verification across rotations, 5) Export audit events + signed proof-of-delivery.
Kai (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: manifest fields: format, files[], merkle_root (opt), signer, key_version, signature, timestamp_token. Example: `{"format":"tar.gz","files":[{"path":"audit.log","sha256":"..."}],"signer":"projects/...","key_version":"v3","signature":"BASE64"}`. MVP skip merkle to keep scope small.
Omar (security): I'll draft rotation/escrow policy: options = tenant-managed KMS (recommended), tenant-uploaded public keys, or third-party escrow. Include verification UX for customers to upload archived public keys and run signature checks.
Rhea (ops): Operationally: exports will be queued/rate-limited. SLA for pilot: small exports (<10GB) ready <24h, large exports best-effort. We'll provide paid "rush" lane. Cost appendix: hot index ~ $0.02-0.03/GB/mo, warm ~ $0.007-0.01, cold ~ $0.0008-0.0015 + retrieval fees.
contracts-bot: Legal note: include SLA appendix for "evidence export availability" and a clause for legal-hold. Recommend 30-day delivery warranty for pilot; will draft wording.
Nina (product): Action items: Kai -> prototype manifest + signed-export CLI sample by Friday; Omar -> rotation+threat-model doc; Rhea -> cost model + ops runbook; contracts -> SLA appendix. I'll collate into PRD and schedule 30m scoping sync.
Kai (eng-runtime): Will post a tiny CLI example: `rw export create --tenant t-42 --since 2026-01-01 --signed=asymmetric` by EOD Fri.
Omar (security): Verification checklist I'll publish: fetch manifest -> verify signature with key_version -> check timestamp token -> spot-check file hashes.
Rhea (ops): I'll include legal-hold test cases and purge blockers in runbook.
Nina (product): Thanks all :thumbsup: Invite incoming.
